title: Distributed Microservices Architecture for High-Concurrency Campus E-Library Systems
author: Ma Ei Ei San
abstract: This thesis presents a resilient, scalable microservices architecture utilizing lightweight event messaging and caching layers to guarantee sub-100ms response times for university digital libraries under peak examination load.

title: Autonomous Navigation and Path Planning for Mobile Robots in GPS-Denied Environments
author: Ko Myo Min Aung
abstract: This research presents an adaptive SLAM-based path planning algorithm for autonomous mobile robots operating in subterranean and indoor environments without GPS availability.

title: Design and Thermal Efficiency Optimization of Solar Parabolic Trough Collectors for Industrial Preheating
author: Ko Zaw Min Tun
abstract: An investigation into geometric and fluid-dynamic parameters affecting heat loss and optical performance in parabolic trough solar concentrators under tropical irradiance conditions.

title: Biophilic Urban Campus Design: Integrating Vernacular Burmese Architecture with Passive Solar Cooling
author: Ma Thiri Shwe Sin
abstract: Explores vernacular Burmese architectural shading principles combined with computational airflow modeling to develop low-energy academic campus buildings in Yangon's climate zone.

title: Seismic Vulnerability Assessment and Non-Linear Pushover Analysis of Multi-Story Concrete Structures
author: Ko Kaung Htet
abstract: Evaluates earthquake-resistant capacity for existing reinforced concrete institutional buildings using ETABS non-linear static pushover methods according to Myanmar National Building Code standards.

title: Optimization of Wellbore Stability and Environmentally Friendly Polymer Drilling Fluids for Deep Gas Formations
author: Ko Ye Yint Kyaw
abstract: Formulates biodegradable polymer-based drilling muds demonstrating superior rheological stability and shale inhibition properties across high-pressure high-temperature offshore reservoir wells.

title: Extraction and Purification of Second-Generation Bioethanol from Rice Husk Biomass via Enzymatic Hydrolysis
author: Ma Hnin Nu Wai
abstract: Investigates dilute acid pre-treatment and simultaneous saccharification fermentation of rice husk agricultural wastes to yield sustainable biofuel with minimum inhibitory byproducts.

title: Design of High-Gain 28 GHz Millimeter-Wave Microstrip Patch Antenna Array for Next-Generation Wireless Communications
author: Ko Sai Wanna
abstract: Presents CST-simulated and fabricated 4x4 planar antenna arrays operating at 28 GHz offering over 14 dBi gain and broad impedance bandwidth suitable for 5G/6G fixed-wireless access transceivers.

title: IoT-Based Smart Energy Monitoring and Load Forecasting for Campus Sub-Stations
author: Ko Aung Kyaw Kyaw
abstract: This thesis proposes an intelligent IoT architecture for monitoring sub-station power quality, phase imbalances, and load distribution with predictive alerts across university campuses.
